Mastered the O(n+m) Merge algorithm for combining sorted lists. Python code:
def merge(f1, f2):
    res = []; i = j = 0
    while i < len(f1) and j < len(f2):
        if f1[i] <= f2[j]: res.append(f1[i]); i += 1
        else: res.append(f2[j]); j += 1
    res.extend(f1[i:]); res.extend(f2[j:])
    return res
